csv_scope_of_work: The State of Florida, Department of Transportation, District 3, may be seeking a consultant to provide Design for SR 10A (US 90) in Escambia County. The consultant will perform all services necessary to produce a complete set of construction plans and bid documents for the resurfacing of SR 10A (US 90) from East of SR 297 to New Warrington Road or SR 10A (US 90) from New Warrington Road to South of Hyde Park Road. Services will include, but are not limited to roadway design, bridge design, signing and pavement marking, lighting, signalization, survey, photogrammetry, and geotechnical. The Department intends to award two contracts from this procurement.
